title: yaks names keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/names adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `by_name` says its entities are addressable by the name a person types — an author is reached as "Ursula Le Guin", where a review is not reached by the sentence it opens with.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [nameKeywords]).

by_name.description: true = this component's entities answer to a name, held in the vocabulary's default name column (`title`). A string names the column instead: "by_name": "label" reads the name from `label`.
